rationale_one_line: mesh-llm's own electric-blue-on-near-black identity (site --blue #3b82f6), in DISPATCH's field-report grammar, for a peer-to-peer network story told as a camera journey through the mesh.
writing_tone_notes: Matter-of-fact and distributed. Show the mechanism, not the scoreboard. Neale's own understated register: state the impossible thing plainly and let the contrast carry it.
do_rules: lead the caption with the growth metric, then a capability fact
use accent-ink for blue TEXT, raw #3b82f6 for the aurora field, dots, glows and the inverted flash
keep the mesh a felt journey (the oner), never a static diagram
dont_rules: no node-diagram of the mesh (the killed default)
no terminal beat (device off-table and it shows a command, not the idea)
no second engagement metric anywhere in the caption
